amendment_reason: The expired revision-11 claim completed only a source audit. Before any strategy outcome was computed, the fixed holding-period and parameter-grid design was replaced by one ML structural first-passage policy so exits are strategy-defined rather than elapsed-time liquidations and research effort is concentrated on one falsifiable information unit.
research_question: At UTC quarter-hour boundaries, does the interaction of completed ten-second aggressive flow, completed price response and strictly prior Binance USD-M open-interest state predict a structural target before a structural stop strongly enough to survive 24 bp, one global slot, funding, capacity and winner-removal stress?

markets.research_source: Binance USD-M perpetual futures official archives

information_contract.entry: next exact one-minute contract open, never an intra-window price
information_contract.metrics: latest official metrics row strictly earlier than event start; 15-minute OI change uses only earlier rows
information_contract.price_features: only completed contract minutes strictly before event start
information_contract.missing_data: no forward fill across signal, entry, target, stop, funding or mark gaps

source_contract.integrity: Every used ZIP must match its adjacent official CHECKSUM.
source_contract.resolution_tail: Three later calendar days are loaded only to resolve a pre-frozen target or stop; unresolved selected paths fail the gate and are never force-closed.
source_contract.capacity: position notional at most 0.1 percent of the immediately preceding completed one-minute quote volume

event_and_path_rules.flow_direction: sign of completed ten-second aggressive quote-notional imbalance
candidate_routes: continuation in flow direction with stop at the pre-event 15-minute opposite extreme
reversal opposite flow with stop beyond the completed ten-second event extreme
event_and_path_rules.minimum_geometry: target distance 30-2000 bp, stop distance 5-1000 bp and reward/risk at least 0.50
event_and_path_rules.label: target-first versus stop-or-unresolved; unresolved is a conservative non-target label
event_and_path_rules.execution: marketable next-minute proxy; exact Bybit BBO remains mandatory before rank eligibility

ml_contract.calibration: one isotonic map fit only on the calibration date
ml_contract.features: completed flow, response efficiency, prior returns/volatility/taker flow, strictly prior OI/positioning, path geometry, symbol, mode, phase and UTC hour
ml_contract.decision: take only the highest expected-edge candidate when calibrated expected target/stop utility exceeds 18 bp cost by at least 5 bp

account_contract.funding: recorded rate and causal official mark
account_contract.gap_risk: adverse open beyond stop is realized at the open
